purpose: Additive Bungie manifest evidence extension for Exotic-first prototypes. No ASTRIX-authored gameplay inference; item identities and perk descriptions are transcribed from Bungie DestinyInventoryItemDefinition pages or manifest identity records.
sourceRoute: Official Bungie DestinyInventoryItemDefinition detail pages; Fusion Grenade identity hash cross-checked against Destiny manifest API records

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie
perks.description: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.

perks.name: Violent Reanimation
perks.description: Multiple final blows with this weapon grant Devour to the wielder.

perks.name: Poison Arrows
perks.description: Arrows fired while perfectly drawn become poison arrows. Precision hits with poison arrows stun the combatant and spread poison to nearby ones.

perks.name: Tap the Trigger
perks.description: Grants a short period of increased stability and accuracy on initial trigger pull.

perks.name: Rampage
perks.description: Kills with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage. Stacks 3x.

perks.name: Repulsor Brace
perks.description: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield.

perks.name: Cosmology
perks.description: Kills with this weapon cause enemy targets to detonate and spawn Void projectiles that track targets.

perks.name: Chaotic Exchanger
perks.description: Resist incoming damage while charging your Void grenade with Chaos Accelerant. Charged Void grenades return grenade energy on a hit and apply Weaken.

perks.name: The Fourth Magic
perks.description: Weapon final blows with a damage type matching your grenade grant Death Throes, which provide a grenade damage bonus and grant you grenade energy.

perks.name: Fusion Harness
perks.description: Fusion Grenades have an additional charge and recharge from empowered weapon damage, with empowered weapon final blows granting more energy. Defeating targets with Fusion Grenades grant Rift energy.

items.name: Fusion Grenade
items.officialDescription: An explosive grenade that attaches to targets, damaging and moderately scorching them on detonation.
